sampling_model.design: Independent sampling from the one coherent joint law \(p_H(V,S)\) with selector support exactly \(H\).
sampling_model.units: Observed units are i.i.d. draws of \((V,S)\); latent roots and response types are not observed.
sampling_model.treatment: The observed treatment components may be natural or selector-overridden according to the known gate encoded by \(S\); the target sets \(A=a\) and \(S=s_{\emptyset}\).
sampling_model.overlap: The proposal maintains the novel restricted-support condition \(p_H(c)>0\) only for structurally admissible cells \(c\in\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}(G^{+})\), with no common numerical lower bound and no law supplied for \(s\notin H\). It guarantees the context normalizers, reachable fixing margins, and certified rational-elimination denominator factors recorded in \(\mathcal L_H^{\mathrm{pos}}\). Statistical inference is pointwise at a fixed differentiable interior point of the returned branch domain.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The positive branch estimates the one finite supported-cell table empirically and evaluates its partial rational circuit only when the empirical table lies in the complete registered positive semialgebraic domain. An off-domain sample returns \(\bot_H\) and no point estimate or confidence set.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Algorithms 1--2 return sound identifying formulas on successful branches.
The systematic-selection algorithm is conjectured to be complete beyond its specified failure branches.
Ordinary semi-Markovian ID is complete through identifying formulas or hedge countermodels.
Positive gID is sound and complete by reduction to classical ID subproblems.
Root-control CSI identification is equivalent to finitely many ordinary graphical identification problems.
Finite canonical SCMs represent all categorical counterfactual distributions and yield sharp polynomial-program bounds.
The arithmetic-circuit method is at least as complete as classical ID and do-calculus under strict positivity and can exploit additional model constraints.
Sufficient pruning and transit-clustering conditions preserve identification conclusions and transport do-calculus functionals.
Influence-function and weight-based estimators are derived for broad classes of identified effects in hidden-variable graphical models.

body.tldr: For a finite selector-gated semi-Markovian SCM observed on exactly \(H\), the independently constructed retained carrier is equivalent to the original parameterization. The repaired SA-CS-ID machine now has one compiler determined solely by the current normalized state: it enumerates actual supported gate occurrences and then applies the fixed nonancestor, district, and reachable-fixing case order, constructing its positivity certificates inductively. Nonresidual progress and simulation of every support-licensed successful Lee--Ghassami--Shpitser trace are proved, so published positive formulas are preserved without installing the successful trace as an agenda. Certificate soundness and finite progress reduce the remaining headline to the explicit all-residual rational-projection-or-global-twin question. That residual exhaustiveness result, including exclusion of identified nonrational residuals, and the strengthened positive-box compiler for ordinary hedges remain open.

project_justification.gap: The published systematic-selection recursion is sound and has branchwise nonidentification results, but its completeness is conjectural and its failure construction is not typed as a support-exact, restricted-interior pair preserving every cell of the one supplied joint law. Its proofs also do not normalize a declared selector support while retaining the exact structural parameter image.
project_justification.niche: Fixed support is neither ordinary observational identification nor gID from separately supplied experiments: absent contexts cannot be invoked, while supported contexts remain coupled by one random selector and shared natural mechanisms.
project_justification.fill: The project constructs the intrinsic normalized carrier \(\Lambda_H\), proves its constrained subset \(\mathcal I_H\) equals the original fixed-support image, and defines an input-determined four-relation machine with exact local algebraic obligations and a denominator positivity ledger. The present repair proves exhaustive nonresidual progress and preservation of all support-licensed successful published derivations. A complete field-level result still requires the residual theorem: every residual-ready state must yield either a verified rational identifying circuit on the full compatible image or a support-exact global-twin box.

body.related_work: Lee, Ghassami, and Shpitser (2024) provide the selector-gated model, Algorithms 1--2, soundness in Theorem 4, branchwise witnesses in Theorem 5, and an explicit completeness conjecture. The fixed compiler proved here simulates every successful support-licensed positive run, but their failure results do not supply the exact-support, restricted-interior global twins required for the residual converse. Shpitser and Pearl (2006) provide ordinary ID formula-or-hedge completeness; translating an arbitrary categorical hedge into this machine's rational-affine positive-box certificate remains an additional obligation rather than an imported conclusion. Kivva, Mokhtarian, Etesami, and Kiyavash (2022) motivate general-identifiability witnesses, but their constructions do not directly establish a common contrast preserving one selector-coupled joint law on exactly \(H\). Zhang, Tian, and Bareinboim (2022) provide finite canonical response types, not exhaustiveness of the present rational projection and signed-row-swap libraries. Tabell, Tikka, and Karvanen (2026) give sufficient graph reductions and formula transport for general data fusion, not inverse fixed-support parameter maps or all-branch twins. Tikka, Hyttinen, and Karvanen (2021) supply the dosearch software consumer.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The input-determined compiler removes the prior possibility of a nonresidual stuck state and the published-trace simulation settles positive preservation. It does not prove that a residual projection or signed-row contrast passes. In an interacting-district residual, fiber constancy could in principle induce an algebraic but nonrational functional, and a local contrast can be annihilated or exposed by observed descendants. The ordinary special case also still lacks the verifier-level arbitrary-alphabet, strictly positive rational-box compilation of a hedge. Boundary-uniform inference, off-domain regularization, and unrestricted quantifier elimination remain outside scope.
body.honest_scope: Established are retained-image normalization, local transition soundness, restricted-support denominator positivity, an explicit current-state agenda compiler, exhaustive nonresidual progress, and operation-by-operation preservation of support-licensed successful Lee--Ghassami--Shpitser formulas. The all-residual formula-or-global-twin dichotomy is still to be proved, including rationality on every identified residual and a common support-preserving contrast on every nonidentified residual. For \(H=\{s_{\emptyset}\}\), the graph, observed-target relation, and nonresidual recursion reduce to ordinary ID, while the stronger rational-affine positive-box encoding of every hedge remains open. No context outside \(H\) is supplied, no uniform positivity constant is assumed, and no completeness conclusion is claimed from generic semialgebraic elimination.
